metadata.Message: Ollama: моделей для чата 3. Список обновляется автоматически.

notes: Actual service source compiled with actual JsonTransport and Core Contracts, not a mocked provider.
Two installed/running/capability refreshes; model capability cache reused on the second refresh.
Unity controller lifetime, UI event loop and throttling require separate NUnit run.
harnessSource:
using System; using System.Linq; using System.Threading.Tasks; using Newtonsoft.Json; using WorldWeaver.Editor.Assistant;
class LiveDiscovery { static async Task<int> Main() { using(var discovery=new OllamaModelDiscovery()) { var first=await discovery.RefreshAsync(); var second=await discovery.RefreshAsync(); Console.WriteLine(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new { serverAvailable=first.ServerAvailable, first.Message, first.CheckedUtc, first.LoadedStateKnown, models=first.Models.Select(m=>new { m.Id,m.Completion,m.CapabilitiesKnown,m.Vision,m.Loaded,m.Remote,m.Parameters }), secondPollAvailable=second.ServerAvailable, generationRequested=false },Formatting.Indented)); return first.ServerAvailable && first.Models.Any(m=>m.Completion) ? 0:1; } } }
limitations: This standalone metadata run does not execute the Unity controller or UI lifecycle.
No model inference, no download, no speed or quality benchmark.
